title: docs(skills): give the requiredWhen alias rule and the flow runAs rule one home each
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"huangyiirene"} -->
_Requested by **Irene** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67x?thread=cmsg_01TJXtQ1tVD26ecLDZxFS67xA5AFaCmiVemTNyDjX44Zt6)_

Part of #31112

Slice 11 of the card: item 1, the first two of its five duplicated-rule groups (`conditionalRequired` → `requiredWhen`, and `runAs` for flows that write `readonly` fields).

## 维护者速读

**需要你做的:** 本 PR 为 **Tier H**(`skills/**`,`check-governed-merges.mjs --test` 实测 GOVERNED、H(人合)),保持 draft;当前 head 还欠契约审查(contract review),由 skills 席位按 `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` 做记录审查,通过后席位再请你批准。
改了什么:两条在多个技能里重复书写的规则,各留一个归属方,其他位置缩成一句带真实锚点的链接。
`conditionalRequired` 已移除这一条:归 `objectstack-data` § Conditional Field Rules;`objectstack-formula`、`objectstack-ui` 的复述删掉,改为链接。
「维护 `readonly` 字段的 flow 用 `runAs: 'system'`、`runAs: 'user'` 写它构建期报错」这一条:归 `objectstack-automation` § Failure routing & `runAs`;`objectstack-data` 的 readonly 条目删掉复述,改为链接,只保留 data 独有的事实(REST/UI 也被剥离、系统 hook/seed/import/migration 豁免、字段保持 `readonly`)。
不改任何规则的教学内容;三个 token 行都缩小(data 6654 → 6606,formula 5973 → 5971,ui 3814 → 3800),automation 未动;`check:skill-links` 验证了两个新锚点。

## Measurement on `main` `351c22c94`: rule statements vs mentions

Only a sentence that states the rule is a duplicate. Every other hit uses the key inside another rule or an example and stays.

**`conditionalRequired` → `requiredWhen`** (`grep -c conditionalRequired`: data 1, formula 1, ui 1)

| File:line | Kind | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| data L225–227 (§ Conditional Field Rules) | states the rule | **owner**, unchanged |
| formula L277–278 (§ 3. Predicate) | states the rule | **duplicate, cut** |
| ui L120–121 (§ Field Conditional Rules in Forms) | states the rule | **duplicate, cut** |
| data L10, L202, L231, L265, L464; formula L5, L75, L97, L428; ui L115 | `requiredWhen` named in a description, an example, or another rule | mention, stays |

**`runAs`** (`grep -c runAs`: automation 12, data 4)

| File:line | Kind | Verdict |
|:--|:--|:--|
| automation L143–197 (§ Failure routing & `runAs`), 12 lines | the readonly-write rule, elevate-the-write, identity assignment, org pinning, hook `runAs` | **owner**, unchanged |
| data L216 "`runAs:'user'` flow — the default" | names who is stripped (data's `readonly` rule); "— the default" restates automation | clause cut, rest stays |
| data L219 "`runAs:'system'` flows, system hooks, seeds, …" | names who is exempt (data's `readonly` rule) | stays |
| data L220–224 | restates the flow-side rule and its build error | **duplicate, cut** |

## Cut list (砍点逐条核幸存)

| # | Cut text (main `351c22c94`) | Surviving home |
|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | formula L277–278: "Never emit `conditionalRequired` (use `requiredWhen`) — it was REMOVED in protocol 17 and is a parse error." | data SKILL.md L225–227, § Conditional Field Rules: "The `conditionalRequired` alias was REMOVED in protocol 17 — emitting it is a parse error." Replaced by a one-line link to that section. |
| 2 | ui L120–121: "Use `requiredWhen` — the `conditionalRequired` alias was REMOVED in protocol 17 and is now a parse error." | Same data section. The paragraph above already pointed there in plain text ("**objectstack-data → Conditional Field Rules**"); that pointer is now a real link. |
| 3 | data L216: the clause "— the default" (a flow's `runAs` defaults to `'user'`) | automation SKILL.md L158–159: "Under the default `runAs: 'user'` the engine **strips** it". |
| 4 | data L220–223: "So the pattern … is expressed by declaring the field `readonly` **and** running the maintaining flow `runAs:'system'` (see **objectstack-automation**), not by removing `readonly`." | Flow side: automation L158–161 ("a flow maintaining one … runs `runAs: 'system'`"). The data-side half, keep the field `readonly`, stays in data as the new sentence "Keep the field `readonly` when automation maintains it". |
| 5 | data L223–224: "Writing a `readonly` field from a `runAs:'user'` `update_record` node is a build-time **error** (`os validate` / `os build`)." | automation L162–163: "`os validate` / `os build` fail a `runAs:'user'` `update_record` writing one (`readonlyWhen`: a warning)". |

The automation owner already states everything the data duplicate said about flows, so no fact moved into an owner. Facts only data held stay in data: REST/UI writes are stripped too; system hooks, seeds, imports and migrations are exempt.

## Diffs

```diff
--- a/skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md
+++ b/skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md
 - **`readonly: true` governs the end-user surface, not trusted system writers.**
-  A non-system write (REST/UI, and any `runAs:'user'` flow — the default) has
+  A non-system write (REST/UI, and any `runAs:'user'` flow) has
   the field **stripped**; the write reports
   success but the value never lands. System-context writes —
   `runAs:'system'` flows, system hooks, seeds, imports, migrations — are exempt
-  and DO write it. So the pattern "users can't edit this, but automation
-  maintains it" is expressed by declaring the field `readonly` **and** running
-  the maintaining flow `runAs:'system'` (see **objectstack-automation**), not by
-  removing `readonly`. Writing a `readonly` field from a `runAs:'user'`
-  `update_record` node is a build-time **error** (`os validate` / `os build`).
+  and DO write it. Keep the field `readonly` when automation maintains it; the
+  flow side: [objectstack-automation → Failure routing & `runAs`](../objectstack-automation/SKILL.md#failure-routing--runas).
```

```diff
--- a/skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md
+++ b/skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md
-Never emit `conditionalRequired` (use `requiredWhen`) — it was REMOVED in
-protocol 17 and is a parse error.
+Conditional requiredness: [objectstack-data](../objectstack-data/SKILL.md#conditional-field-rules).
```

```diff
--- a/skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md
+++ b/skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md
 ObjectUI forms consume them. Their semantics and server behaviour:
-**objectstack-data → Conditional Field Rules**.
+[objectstack-data → Conditional Field Rules](../objectstack-data/SKILL.md#conditional-field-rules).

 UI-side: inline master-detail grids evaluate these rules **row-by-row** against
-each child row. Use `requiredWhen` — the `conditionalRequired` alias was REMOVED
-in protocol 17 and is now a parse error.
+each child row.
```

Plus `.changeset/31112-skills-requiredwhen-runas-one-home.md` (`'@objectstack/skills': patch`).

## Token ratchet (`scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`)

| File | main | this PR | ceiling |
|:--|--:|--:|--:|
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` | 6654 | 6606 (−48) | 6665 |
| `skills/objectstack-formula/SKILL.md` | 5973 | 5971 (−2) | 5997 |
| `skills/objectstack-ui/SKILL.md` | 3814 | 3800 (−14) | 3814 |
| `skills/objectstack-automation/SKILL.md` | 6687 | 6687 (0, untouched) | 6687 |

Every row shrinks or holds. The ceilings are shrink-only and are not lowered here: that edit is in `scripts/`, outside this slice's file surface.

## Evals and pins

An eval tests what a reader of the whole package can answer, and every cut rule still lives in its owner, so no eval changes. Per hit:

- `objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` case 4 ("never the removed `conditionalRequired` alias", `must_not_contain: "conditionalRequired:"`): the owner text is untouched, so it stays true.
- `objectstack-formula/evals/cel-predicates-formulas.json` case 5 and `objectstack-ui/evals/views-apps-actions-pages.json` case 1 (`must_not_contain: "conditionalRequired:"`): guards against emitting the key, not quotes of the cut sentence. The rule is one link away in data. They stay true.
- `objectstack-automation/evals/flows-triggers-approvals.json` cases at L7, L193, L320, L339 and `integrations-declared.json` L17 (`runAs: 'system'` / `'user'`): automation's text is untouched. They stay true.
- No data eval asserts the `readonly` strip or the `runAs` build error.

Pins: no `packages/*/src/**/*.test.ts` or `scripts/**` gate quotes any changed line. Grepped for each cut phrase; the only hits are code comments (`packages/lint/src/validate-readonly-flow-writes.ts` L37, `packages/spec/src/kernel/metadata-plugin.test.ts` L317) that do not read the skill. `check-skill-identifier-liveness` registers no section touched here.

## Contract review

`dispatch-gates --tier` mandates `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` for `skills/**` (clause ①). The maintainer's standing order for card threads (2026-11-03) waives that tier for the build; the skills seat runs the contract review of record at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`.
